messages.subject: Project Juniper - LSA first draft
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Jonathan,

Please find our first draft of the Logistics Services Agreement (v1) sent via the data room. It includes the Statement of Work, charging schedule and SLA. We've worked to the heads of terms - liability cap is at 125% and there's a weight-based sub-limit on goods liability which we can discuss.

We'd be grateful for your mark-up in the next fortnight to keep us on track for a 1 July go-live.

Kind regards,
James Osei
Whitfield Carter LLP

Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
